definitionZh: 披露是一个小部件，可以折叠（隐藏）或展开（可见）内容。它有两个元素：一个公开按钮和一个其可见性由按钮控制的内容部分。当受控内容被隐藏时，该按钮通常被设计为带有向右箭头或三角形的典型按钮，以暗示激活该按钮将显示其他内容。当内容可见时，箭头或三角形通常指向下方。
sourceDefinition: A disclosure is a widget that enables content to be either collapsed (hidden) or expanded (visible). It has two elements: a disclosure button and a section of content whose visibility is controlled by the button. When the controlled content is hidden, the button is often styled as a typical push button with a right-pointing arrow or triangle to hint that activating the button will display additional content. When the content is visible, the arrow or triangle typically points down.
